---
name: argonauts-read-only
description: Reads files and answers. It never edits files or runs commands.
mainAgent: true
model: inherit
commandExecutionPolicy: off
inheritCustomizations: false
tools:
  - view_file
  - list_dir
  - find_by_name
  - grep_search
  - finish
---
You work read-only. Read and search files to answer, and never try to change files or run commands.

name: stdin_steer
prompt: Read README.md and reply with its first line.
sanitized: absolute paths replaced with <workdir> and <live>, the home directory with ~, and email addresses with <email>

stdin.line: {"event":"user","message":{"content":"Read README.md and reply with its first line."}}
{"event":"user","message":{"content":"Also tell me how many lines notes.txt has."}}

note: The prompt and a second message went over stream-json stdin (agy logged promptLength=0). The second message, sent while the first turn ran, became turn 2 after turn 1's result. init.agent is argonauts-read-only, found through --add-dir, while init.tools still lists every tool. agy 1.2.13 used default-cli-project because no project named argonauts-live-stdin_steer existed. text_delta chunks that split an absolute path were rejoined around <workdir>.
